test-plans.title: Test plans
test-plans.intro: Version the intended checks, then inspect exact execution reports. Test execution and human acceptance remain separate.
test-plans.no_plans: No test plans yet. Create one for an existing task.
test-plans.one_plan_per_task: Each task has one versioned test plan.
test-plans.no_criteria: This task has no acceptance criteria. No coverage is inferred.
test-plans.basis_changed: The plan source changed. Review the current task and its criteria before saving a new draft. Old execution reports retain their original revision.
test-plans.adopt_current_basis: I reviewed the current task, requirement version and each coverage index.
test-plans.automatic_only: Automatic cases use exact JUnit class and test names. A draft does not create a passing result.
test-plans.draft_can_be_incomplete: Save an incomplete draft; finish its checks before publication.
test-plans.version_changed: A newer plan version is available. Review it before saving; your local draft is retained.
test-plans.publication_hint: Publish the reviewed revision before dispatching the existing task. Publishing a plan does not start a test or grant acceptance.
test-plans.results_boundary: These results come from captured reports bound to the published plan, exact run, attempt and code source. Missing, skipped, unknown and ambiguous results never count as passing.
test-plans.no_executions: No executions bound to this plan
test-plans.dispatch_existing_task: Publish the plan, then dispatch the linked task using its existing development workflow.
test-plans.execution_basis_changed: This execution no longer matches the current plan or task basis. Its original results remain visible.
test-plans.no_reports: No captured reports are available. No test pass is inferred.
test-plans.defect_hint: Create an issue from this exact failing case. The normal issue workflow handles diagnosis, repair and requirement feedback.
test-plans.defect_saved: Issue registered with the exact case evidence.
test-plans.defect_target_changed: This failure changed. Close this dialog and review the current result before registering an issue.
test-plans.restore_hint: Recover the same request and operation key. A later plan version does not replace the original command.
test-plans.access_changed: Access changed. Protected facts were cleared; retry explicitly.
test-plans.invalid_read: The selected plan or evidence response could not be verified. Read it again before acting.
test-plans.refresh_failed: The saved operation is retained, but the current view could not be refreshed.
test-plans.existing_plan_hint: This task may already have a plan. Load the plan list and explicitly open its current record before retrying.
test-plans.steps_hint: One step per line; up to 20 steps.
test-plans.selector_hint: Exact, case-sensitive match to the original report.
test-plans.case_no_evidence: No matched report evidence for this case.
test-plans.no_code_source: No code source is recorded for this execution.
test-plans.validation.title_required: Enter a plan title within 200 UTF-8 bytes.
test-plans.validation.case_limit: A plan supports up to 100 cases.
test-plans.validation.invalid_key: Case keys must be unique letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, up to 64 characters.
test-plans.validation.text_limit: A field or case collection exceeds its supported size.
test-plans.validation.covers_invalid: Coverage must use unique, valid indices of the current task criteria.
test-plans.validation.selector_duplicate: Each completed class and test-name pair must be unique.
test-plans.eligibility.source_changed: The published source changed; new adoption requires a reviewed revision.
test-plans.eligibility.retired: The publication is retired. Earlier results remain traceable.
test-plans.no_bound_revision: No published plan bound at dispatch
test-plans.empty_original: No original XML bytes were captured.
test-plans.report_counts: {{total}} reported · {{passed}} passed · {{failed}} failed or errored · {{skipped}} skipped
test-plans.report_unverified: This report has no currently verified case projection.
test-plans.package_checks_help: Package checks and JUnit case results are evaluated separately.
test-plans.package_defect_hint: Record what you observed. The issue links to this package test attempt for diagnosis and repair.
test-plans.package_defect_saved: Issue registered and linked to the package test attempt.
